summary: G4 implemented the independent taskbar metrics window, four presentation variants with edge-derived production orientation, G2-backed dock/drag behavior, allowed-subset settings, About and one-request Gitee release checks, and real release smoke. Package tests and clippy pass; TASK-014 remains blocked because all 60 observed Private Bytes samples exceeded the 10 MiB gate.

evidence.taskbar: 16 presentation/edge cells are covered by deterministic geometry tests; production normalization maps Top/Bottom to horizontal and Left/Right to vertical; Slint model updates values in place while layout tokens rebuild only for style/orientation/columns/unit/gap changes
evidence.settings: GET and PUT mock covers allowed subset, missing/unknown keys, clamps and invalid JSON; deferred system controls are absent from request bodies
evidence.update: 404, malformed metadata, same/newer release and server failure are deterministic; newer-release test observed exactly one GET request
evidence.smoke: release process used winit-software; logs recorded distinct dual HWND wiring, taskbar placement, independent dual SSE startup, and G4 taskbar/settings/About show path; Orca observed the live xhm-desktop UI
evidence.memory: 60 one-second release samples: min 34.504 MiB, max 34.719 MiB, 0/60 below 10 MiB; gate failed
evidence.anti_pattern: zero prohibited update-side-effect patterns and zero RegisterHotKey/WM_HOTKEY/Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X matches
